meme_createBody.en: What you've entered won't be saved.
meme_createBody.zh: 已填写的内容不会保存。

meme_createConfirmStep.en: The address is set at creation

meme_createErrorText.en: Enter an amount greater than 0, up to 18 decimal places
meme_createErrorText.zh: 请输入大于 0 的金额，最多 18 位小数

meme_createIf.en: Only links starting with https:// are supported
meme_createIf.zh: 只支持 https:// 开头的链接

meme_createIf2.en: You've used up today's creations. Come back tomorrow
meme_createIf2.zh: 今天的创建次数用完了，明天再来

meme_createIf4.zh: 超过单钱包上限 {memeTokenFigure} 枚

meme_createMediaStep.en: Square image, crop before uploading. Without one, the symbol's first letter is used.
meme_createMediaStep.zh: 方形图片，上传前可裁剪；不传就用符号首字母。

meme_createMemeCreateBlockedTitle.en: Tokens can't be created right now

meme_createMemeCreateEvidencePendingBody.en: Contract check in progress. Creating may be unavailable for now.
meme_createMemeCreateEvidencePendingBody.zh: 合约核对中，创建可能暂时不可用。

meme_createMemeCreateNoVanityBody.en: A 6666 suffix can't be assigned this time. The token can still be created and traded normally.
meme_createMemeCreateNoVanityBody.zh: 本次无法分配 6666 尾号，代币仍可正常创建和交易。

meme_createMemeCreateNoWalletBody2.en: No wallet available yet. Create or activate one in Wallet first.
meme_createMemeCreateNoWalletBody2.zh: 还没有可用的钱包，先在钱包里创建或激活一个。

meme_createMemeCreateRetiredOpenV2Messag.en: Use Loop Hook launch (v2 launch) to create new tokens.
meme_createMemeCreateRetiredOpenV2Messag.zh: 请使用 Loop Hook 发射（v2 发射）创建新代币。

meme_createS.en: This device can't pick images right now. Without one, the symbol's first letter is used.
meme_createS.zh: 这台设备暂时不能选图，不传就用符号首字母。

meme_createSwitch2.zh: 符号 2–10 位字母或数字

meme_createText.en: About {memeTokenLabel}, fee {memeUsd1Label}, limit {memeTokenFigure}. The server quote applies before signing.
meme_createText.zh: 约得 {memeTokenLabel}，手续费 {memeUsd1Label}；上限 {memeTokenFigure} 枚。签名前以服务端报价为准。

meme_createValue3.en: Lists on PancakeSwap automatically once the sale portion sells out
meme_createValue3.zh: 可售部分卖完后自动上 PancakeSwap

meme_createValue4.en: Lists on PancakeSwap automatically after raising about {memeUsd1Label}
meme_createValue4.zh: 募满约 {memeUsd1Label} 后自动上 PancakeSwap

meme_formatSwitch10.en: This transaction expired (not signed within about 30 seconds). Start again
meme_formatSwitch10.zh: 这笔交易已过期（约 30 秒内未签名），请重新发起

meme_formatSwitch11.en: This transaction is no longer valid. Start again
meme_formatSwitch11.zh: 这笔交易已失效，请重新发起

meme_formatSwitch15.zh: 超过单钱包 4,000 万枚上限

meme_formatSwitch17.en: Some details aren't valid. Check the name, symbol, bio and links
meme_formatSwitch17.zh: 资料不符合要求，请检查名称、符号、简介和链接

meme_formatSwitch18.en: This image wasn't uploaded by this account. Upload it again
meme_formatSwitch18.zh: 这张图片不是当前账号上传的，请重新上传

meme_formatSwitch19.en: The quote changed. Get a new quote
meme_formatSwitch19.zh: 报价已变化，请重新报价

meme_formatSwitch2.en: DEX pool market data can't be loaded

meme_formatSwitch20.en: The on-chain transaction doesn't match what you confirmed
meme_formatSwitch20.zh: 链上交易与确认内容不符

meme_formatSwitch21.en: The transaction didn't succeed on chain

meme_formatSwitch22.en: This transaction hasn't appeared on chain for a while
meme_formatSwitch22.zh: 迟迟没有看到这笔交易上链

meme_formatSwitch23.en: Simulation failed. Get a new quote
meme_formatSwitch23.zh: 试算没有通过，请重新报价

meme_formatSwitch24.en: Can't simulate right now. Try again later
meme_formatSwitch24.zh: 暂时无法试算，请稍后再试

meme_formatSwitch25.en: Approval needed first. Can't simulate before approval
meme_formatSwitch25.zh: 需要先授权，授权前无法试算

meme_formatSwitch27.en: On-chain data can't be loaded right now

meme_formatSwitch31.en: Launchpad service isn't available right now
meme_formatSwitch31.zh: 发射台服务暂时不可用

meme_formatSwitch32.zh: 发射台合约还没有配置

meme_formatSwitch35.en: This transaction isn't allowed right now
meme_formatSwitch35.zh: 这笔交易暂不在允许范围内

meme_formatSwitch4.en: Price can't be loaded right now

meme_homeTopIf.en: Can't reach LOOP right now, so the balance can't be loaded
meme_homeTopIf.zh: 暂时连不上 LOOP，余额读不到

meme_homeTopReason.en: Wallet balance can't be loaded right now

meme_homeTopReason4.en: {count} assets have no price yet, so total assets aren't shown
meme_homeTopReason4.zh: {count} 项资产暂无价格，总资产暂不显示

meme_launchpadEmptyMessage.en: No tokens yet. Create the first one
meme_launchpadEmptyMessage.zh: 还没有代币，来创建第一个

meme_launchpadEmptyMessage3.en: Platform MEME assets appear here once they're live
meme_launchpadEmptyMessage3.zh: 平台 MEME 资产上线后在这里显示

meme_launchpadIf.en: Can't reach LOOP right now, so the Launchpad can't be loaded
meme_launchpadIf.zh: 暂时连不上 LOOP，发射台读不到

meme_launchpadMemeEmptyCreateMessage.en: Classic launch is retired. Use v2 launch for new tokens
meme_launchpadMemeEmptyCreateMessage.zh: 经典发射已停用，新代币请走 v2 发射

meme_launchpadMemeEmptyCreateMessage2.en: Create the first one. It lists on PancakeSwap automatically when filled
meme_launchpadMemeEmptyCreateMessage2.zh: 来创建第一个，打满自动上 PancakeSwap

meme_launchpadMemeListProvenanceDetail.en: Bonding pool token prices and market caps come from the LOOP curve. Graduated tokens come from DexScreener. Tokens without a price show the reason instead of 0.
meme_launchpadMemeListProvenanceDetail.zh: 内盘代币的价格与市值读自 LOOP 曲线，已毕业代币读自 DexScreener；读不到价格的代币写明原因，不会显示 0。

meme_launchpadMemeMarketProvenanceDetail.en: {orderingLabel}. Bonding pool tokens come from the LOOP curve and graduated tokens from DexScreener. Tokens without a quote show the reason.
meme_launchpadMemeMarketProvenanceDetail.zh: {orderingLabel}。内盘代币读自 LOOP 曲线，已毕业代币读自 DexScreener；读不到报价的代币写明原因。

meme_launchpadS.zh: 发射台状态还没有读到

meme_screenLaunch2ListAllUnavailableMess.en: MEME v2 isn't available right now · {launch2CapabilityText}

meme_signingIf.en: Approval broadcast ({memeShortAddress}), but the wallet result of the {noun} transaction is unknown, so it's locked. Don't sign again. Refresh later.
meme_signingIf.zh: 授权已广播（{memeShortAddress}），但{noun}交易的钱包结果未知，已锁定。不要重复签名，稍后刷新查看。

meme_signingIf2.en: The wallet result is unknown, so this {noun} is locked. Don't sign again. Refresh later.
meme_signingIf2.zh: 钱包的结果未知，这笔{noun}已锁定。不要重复签名，稍后刷新查看。

meme_signingIf3.en: Broadcast ({short}) and recorded by the server. Broadcast doesn't mean filled. Waiting for on-chain confirmation.
meme_signingIf3.zh: 已广播（{short}），服务端已记录。广播不代表已成交，正在等待链上确认。

meme_signingPollTimedOut.en: Broadcast, but no confirmation yet. It may still be confirming, so check again later. Don't repeat the {noun}.
meme_signingPollTimedOut.zh: 已广播，但还没有读到确认。它可能仍在确认中，请稍后再查；不要重复{noun}。

meme_signingPreparing.en: Preparing {noun}. The wallet isn't open yet.
meme_signingPreparing.zh: 正在准备{noun}，还没有打开钱包。

meme_signingReason.en: Your wallet opens twice: approve first, then {memeIntentNoun}. The approval covers only this transaction.
meme_signingReason.zh: 会依次打开两次钱包：先授权，再{memeIntentNoun}。授权金额只够这一笔。

meme_signingSetState.en: Approval broadcast, but {memeIntentNoun} wasn't signed, so no {memeIntentNoun2} transaction was submitted. Close and start again.
meme_signingSetState.zh: 授权已广播，{memeIntentNoun}没有签名，没有提交{memeIntentNoun2}交易。可以关闭后重新发起。

meme_signingSwitch.zh: 已取消，没有发生任何变化。

meme_signingSwitch10.en: Simulation failed, so this transaction would be rejected on chain. Nothing was submitted. Get a new quote.
meme_signingSwitch10.zh: 试算没有通过，这笔交易在链上会被拒绝。没有提交任何交易，请重新报价。

meme_signingSwitch11.en: The wallet didn't finish signing. Nothing was submitted.
meme_signingSwitch11.zh: 钱包没有完成签名，没有提交任何交易。

meme_signingSwitch12.en: A different hash was already reported for this transaction, so this broadcast wasn't recorded. It may already be on chain. Don't sign again.
meme_signingSwitch12.zh: 这笔交易已经上报过另一笔哈希，本次广播没有被记录。交易可能已经上链，不要重复签名。

meme_signingSwitch13.en: The server no longer accepts reports for this transaction. The wallet already broadcast it and it may be on chain. Don't sign again.
meme_signingSwitch13.zh: 服务端已不再接受这笔交易的上报。钱包已经广播，交易可能已经上链，不要重复签名。

meme_signingSwitch14.en: This transaction expired and isn't visible on chain yet, so the report wasn't accepted. It may still be propagating. Don't sign again.
meme_signingSwitch14.zh: 这笔交易已过期，链上暂时还看不到它，上报没有被接受。交易可能仍在传播，不要重复签名。

meme_signingSwitch15.en: The on-chain transaction doesn't match what you confirmed, so the server didn't record it. Don't sign again, and contact support.
meme_signingSwitch15.zh: 链上这笔交易与确认内容不一致，服务端没有记录它。不要重复签名，并联系支持。

meme_signingSwitch16.en: The wallet already broadcast, but this report wasn't accepted or didn't arrive. The transaction may be on chain. You can report again later. Don't sign again.
meme_signingSwitch16.zh: 钱包已经广播，但这次上报没有被服务端接受或没有送达。交易可能已经上链，可以稍后重新上报；不要重复签名。

meme_signingSwitch17.en: Approval broadcast, but {noun} wasn't signed. You can start again.
meme_signingSwitch17.zh: 授权已广播，{noun}没有签名。可以重新发起。

meme_signingSwitch18.en: This {noun} is locked. Don't sign again.
meme_signingSwitch18.zh: 这笔{noun}已锁定，不要重复签名。

meme_signingSwitch2.zh: 身份验证没有通过，没有发生任何变化。

meme_signingSwitch3.en: This transaction expired. Nothing was submitted. Start again.
meme_signingSwitch3.zh: 这笔交易已过期，没有提交任何交易。请重新发起。

meme_signingSwitch4.en: The transaction doesn't match what you confirmed, so signing was refused. Nothing was submitted.
meme_signingSwitch4.zh: 交易内容与确认内容不一致，已拒绝签名，没有提交任何交易。

meme_signingSwitch5.en: The wallet for this transaction isn't in your wallet list. Nothing was submitted.
meme_signingSwitch5.zh: 钱包目录里找不到这笔交易的钱包，没有提交任何交易。

meme_signingSwitch6.en: The server built this transaction for a different wallet, so signing was refused. Nothing was submitted.
meme_signingSwitch6.zh: 服务端构造交易用的钱包与当前钱包不一致，已拒绝签名，没有提交任何交易。

meme_signingSwitch7.en: Signing isn't allowed on this chain. Nothing was submitted.
meme_signingSwitch7.zh: 这条链不允许签名，没有提交任何交易。

meme_signingSwitch8.en: The wallet can't sign on this chain right now. Nothing was submitted.
meme_signingSwitch8.zh: 钱包暂时不能在这条链上签名，没有提交任何交易。

meme_signingSwitch9.en: The signed-in wallet isn't this transaction's wallet. Nothing was submitted.
meme_signingSwitch9.zh: 当前登录的钱包不是这笔交易的钱包，没有提交任何交易。

meme_signingWaiting.en: Broadcast, waiting for on-chain confirmation (checked {attempts} times). Don't repeat the {noun}.
meme_signingWaiting.zh: 已广播，正在等待链上确认（已读取 {attempts} 次）。不要重复{noun}。

meme_tokenDetail.en: Holding = net curve buys minus sells. Transfers between wallets don't count. Share is out of a 1B total supply.
meme_tokenDetail.zh: 持仓 = 曲线买入减卖出的净额，钱包之间的转账不计；占比以 10 亿总量为分母。

meme_tokenDetail2.en: Buy amounts are what was paid (including the 1% fee, excluding refunds). Sell amounts are what was received (after fees).
meme_tokenDetail2.zh: 买入金额是实付（含 1% 手续费、不含退回），卖出金额是实收（已扣费）。

meme_tokenGraduatedChartHint.en: See the DEX pool market for the trend after graduation.
meme_tokenGraduatedChartHint.zh: 毕业后的走势在外盘行情里看。

meme_tokenIf.zh: {holderCount} 个持有者 · 按曲线买卖统计

meme_tokenLoopInlineUnavailable.en: This token was hidden from the Launchpad · {text}
meme_tokenLoopInlineUnavailable.zh: 运营已将此代币从发射台隐藏 · {text}

meme_tokenLoopInlineUnavailable2.en: This token was hidden from the Launchpad
meme_tokenLoopInlineUnavailable2.zh: 运营已将此代币从发射台隐藏

meme_tokenMemeAboutDexSubtitle.zh: 毕业后的价格与 K 线

meme_tokenMemeAboutProvenanceDetail.en: Curve status, holders and trades come from LOOP's index of curve contract events. Only tokens created through LOOP are listed.
meme_tokenMemeAboutProvenanceDetail.zh: 曲线状态、持有者与成交读自 LOOP 对曲线合约事件的索引；只列出经 LOOP 创建的代币。

meme_tokenMemeAboutResidualMessage.en: The DEX pool exists. Some funds remain in the contract
meme_tokenMemeAboutResidualMessage.zh: 外盘池已存在，部分资金留在合约

meme_tokenMemeCandlesProvenanceDetail.en: Prices after each curve trade are grouped into candles by interval. Empty intervals aren't filled.{series}

series.example: series.frozenAt == null ? '' : '毕业后的走势在外盘行情里看。'

meme_tokenMemeCandlesProvenanceDetail.zh: 每笔曲线成交后的价格按时段聚成 K 线；空时段不补。{series}

meme_tokenMemeChartEmptyMessage.en: A few more trades and the trend will appear
meme_tokenMemeChartEmptyMessage.zh: 多几笔成交，走势就会画出来

meme_tokenMemeTokenEvidencePendingMessag.en: Contract check in progress. Trading may be unavailable for now
meme_tokenMemeTokenEvidencePendingMessag.zh: 合约核对中，交易可能暂时不可用

meme_tokenMemeTokenGraduatedCloseBody.en: The curve is filled, the token is on PancakeSwap and the LP is burned.
meme_tokenMemeTokenGraduatedCloseBody.zh: 曲线已打满，代币已上 PancakeSwap，LP 已烧毁。

meme_tokenMemeTokenInvalidIdentityMessag.en: No data was requested and no other token was used instead.
meme_tokenMemeTokenInvalidIdentityMessag.zh: 没有请求任何数据，也没有回退到其他代币。

meme_tokenMemeTokenInvalidIdentityTitle.en: No usable token ID in the route
meme_tokenMemeTokenInvalidIdentityTitle.zh: 路由中没有可用的代币标识

meme_tokenMemeTokenLiquidityLowBody.en: Low liquidity · Bonding pool reserve {memeCapLabel}. Large buys have high slippage
meme_tokenMemeTokenLiquidityLowBody.zh: 流动性低 · 内盘储备 {memeCapLabel}，大额买入滑点高

meme_tokenMemeTokenPriceProvenanceDetail.en: Bonding pool price = ratio of the curve's virtual reserves. Market cap = price × 1B total supply.
meme_tokenMemeTokenPriceProvenanceDetail.zh: 内盘价格 = 曲线虚拟储备之比，市值 = 价格 × 10 亿总量。

meme_tokenMemeTokenPriceProvenanceDetail.en: Price and market cap after graduation come from DexScreener.
meme_tokenMemeTokenPriceProvenanceDetail.zh: 毕业后的价格与市值读自 DexScreener。

meme_tokenMessage3.en: Holders appear here after the first buy
meme_tokenMessage3.zh: 第一笔买入后，持有者会出现在这里

meme_tokenMessage4.en: Trades appear here after a buy or sell
meme_tokenMessage4.zh: 买入或卖出后，成交会出现在这里

meme_tokenS.en: {holderCount} holders · Counted from curve trades · Frozen at graduation
meme_tokenS.zh: {holderCount} 个持有者 · 按曲线买卖统计 · 分布冻结于毕业时

meme_tokenShare2.zh: 在 LOOP 发射台查看

meme_tokenSubtitle.en: The creator has no public profile

meme_tradePanelIf.zh: 超过单钱包 {memeTokenFigure} 枚上限

meme_tradePanelIf2.en: This amount gets no tokens. Adjust it
meme_tradePanelIf2.zh: 这个金额得不到代币，请调整

meme_tradePanelMemeTradeQuoteEmpty2.en: Enter an amount to see a quote

meme_tradePanelMemeTradeQuoteProvenanceD.en: The quote uses the current on-chain curve.
meme_tradePanelMemeTradeQuoteProvenanceD.zh: 报价按链上当前曲线计算。

meme_tradePanelMemeTradeQuoteProvenanceD.en: On-chain reads aren't available, so the quote uses the index snapshot and may lag a few blocks.
meme_tradePanelMemeTradeQuoteProvenanceD.zh: 链上暂时读不到，报价按索引快照计算，可能落后几个区块。

meme_tradePanelS.en: Exceeds the per-wallet limit. You can buy up to {memeTokenLabel} more
meme_tradePanelS.zh: 超过单钱包上限，最多还能买 {memeTokenLabel}
